description: Generate a memorable passphrase from random dictionary words with optional number and symbol suffixes. Uses a ~500-word curated list for good entropy.

capitalize.description: Capitalize each word. Defaults to true.

includeNumber.description: Append a random number (0-99) at the end. Defaults to true.

includeSymbol.description: Append a random symbol at the end. Defaults to true.

wordCount.description: Number of words to include. Defaults to 3.

name: password_generate_memorable
